description.en: Tuxedo, check; white shirt, check. This little acrobat is permanently dressed to impress! Rocking a sharp look that says he’s always ready for a gala—or a high-speed chase. Whether it’s 3 AM zoomies or an intense battle with a shoelace, he brings his own brand of high-fashion entertainment to every moment.
